'''Disruption gloves''', also known as '''disruptor gloves''', were a rare type of [[Glove/Legends|glove]] in use during a series of conflicts fought between the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] known as the [[Dark Wars]]. During [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], the gloves allowed a user to penetrate many types of defenses, including [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].

==Description==
Disruption [[Glove/Legends|gloves]],<ref name="kotor2" /> also called [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] gloves,<ref name="kotor2g">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> were designed to help an individual get through various defenses during [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] by causing additional damage. Like disruptor weapons of their [[Time/Legends|time]], the gloves caused damage that penetrated [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. The gloves were a [[Color/Legends|light blue]] color on the outside and dark brown on the inside.<ref name="kotor2" />

==History==
Although they were quite rare, disruption gloves were in use soon after the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="kotor2" /> during a series of conflicts known as the [[Dark Wars]]<ref name="kotorcg" /> which were fought between the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="kotor2" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> disruption gloves could sell for around 26,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The disruption gloves first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Obsidian Entertainment]]. In ''The Sith Lords'', the gloves were a rare item that could be found in randomly determined locations throughout the game, and because of this, the player was not guaranteed to find them every time through the game. The gloves granted a very large shield-penetrating damage bonus to unarmed attacks.<ref name="kotor2" /> They also received an entry in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' by [[Prima Games]] although they were referred to as "disruptor gloves."<ref name="kotor2g" />
